versions.content: function operator= [SWS_PHM_01151] Upstream: RS_HM_09159 , RS_AP_00159 RecoveryAction & operator= ( RecoveryAction &&ra)=delete; The move assignment operator for the RecoveryAction shall not be used. Rationale: Using the move assignment after a RecoveryAction instance has been offered may result in premature invocation of RecoveryHandler before the derived class is fully constructed. This can lead to undefined behavior or unhandled exceptions, compromising system stability and safety. Description:
The move assignment operator for the RecoveryAction shall not be used.
Rationale: Using the move assignment after a RecoveryAction instance has been offered may
result in premature invocation of RecoveryHandler before the derived class is fully constructed.
This can lead to undefined behavior or unhandled exceptions, compromising system stability
and safety.
